ctx.x: that was the end of my interest in it. What about the lake? Did they have music out

that much in those breaks over the water? Yes. There were hotels on the lake. In fact, the man that built the original, Arlie Sater, John Davis, had a hotel on the lake at one time, and they had music in those hotels for dancing, because hardly anything that didn't have dancing that connected with it existed. They even had dancing as far up here as Bay St. Louis, and ran special cruise boats from here for a weekend, you see, in Bay St. Louis, bringing the businessmen back to work in time for Monday morning after…
That's how far you've gotten now, you've returned to it. 1841. 1841. Well, I've gone through some,
